expectedToSurvive.note: reads model output keys without the own-property check
expectedToSurvive.why: The only keys read (merchants, categories, perOrderCap, ...) are not names found on Object.prototype, so no input can tell the two apart.

expectedToSurvive.note: a single line with a quantity of exactly 100 passes the per-line check
expectedToSurvive.why: The same limit is checked a second time after repeated lines are merged, which rejects 100 with the same error code. Only the list of offending SKUs inside the error can differ.
